agent_priors_used: General prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): a benchmark whose cold/retrieval baselines sit at a 1.0 correctness ceiling cannot support a cost-per-success advantage, so non-ceiling dynamic range must be certified before any four-arm run.

General prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): memoryful baselines that retain within-session state are strong comparators; a treatment's dynamic range must survive a full within-session receipt/chain comparator, not only a memoryless one.

General prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): when one estimator/substrate design repeatedly yields MEASUREMENT_INVALID, that is an instrumentation or prerequisite defect to repair once, not a scientific negative to re-run in each lane.
General prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): already-frozen transactions should be completed under their frozen design before strategic redirection; only pre-freeze work may be superseded by a new mandate.

General prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): an independent declared grammar or applicability guard can raise safe coverage where a purely data-driven support-widening rule over-generalizes, and explicit refusal is preferable to an unsafe accept.

General prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): cross-vantage (distinct egress) replication is the standard robustness test for a single-vantage network measurement, and difficulty provisioning a second egress is itself a decisive operational finding.
